description: Parse a standard 5-field cron expression (or an @daily-style macro), describe in words when it fires, and compute its next run times in UTC. Use it to check a schedule before deploying it — computing cron fire times by reasoning alone is error-prone, especially with day-of-month and day-of-week both set.

count.description: How many upcoming run times to return.

expression.description: Cron expression: "minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week", e.g. "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5".

from.description: ISO 8601 instant to compute runs after. Defaults to now.

name: cron_explain
title: Explain a cron expression
